instruments.name: PHQ-9 — Patient Health Questionnaire (depression)
instruments.stem: Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you been bothered by any of the following problems?
instruments.scale: 0 = not at all · 1 = several days · 2 = more than half the days · 3 = nearly every day
items: Little interest or pleasure in doing things
Trouble falling or staying asleep, or sleeping too much
Feeling tired or having little energy
Feeling bad about yourself — or that you are a failure
Moving or speaking slowly, or being fidgety/restless
Thoughts that you would be better off dead, or of hurting yourself
instruments.scoring: Sum 0–27. 0–4 none/minimal · 5–9 mild · 10–14 moderate · 15–19 mod-severe · 20–27 severe.
instruments.safety: Item 9 > 0 forces MCS red/critical irrespective of total and fires the crisis pathway (Doc 11). Never averaged away.

instruments.name: PHQ-2 — ultra-brief depression screen
instruments.stem: Over the last 2 weeks, how often bothered by…
instruments.scale: 0 = not at all · 1 = several days · 2 = more than half the days · 3 = nearly every day
items: Little interest or pleasure in doing things

instruments.name: GAD-7 — Generalized Anxiety Disorder
instruments.stem: Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you been bothered by the following problems?
instruments.scale: 0 = not at all · 1 = several days · 2 = more than half the days · 3 = nearly every day
items: Feeling nervous, anxious, or on edge
Not being able to stop or control worrying
Worrying too much about different things
Being so restless that it is hard to sit still
Feeling afraid as if something awful might happen

instruments.name: GAD-2 — ultra-brief anxiety screen
instruments.scale: 0 = not at all · 1 = several days · 2 = more than half the days · 3 = nearly every day
instruments.stem: Over the last 2 weeks, how often bothered by…
items: Feeling nervous, anxious, or on edge
Not being able to stop or control worrying

instruments.name: AUDIT-C — alcohol use
instruments.stem: Alcohol consumption screen (WHO).
items: How often do you have a drink containing alcohol? (0 never … 4 ≥4×/week)
How many standard drinks on a typical drinking day? (0:1–2 … 4:≥10)
How often do you have ≥6 drinks on one occasion? (0 never … 4 daily/almost)
instruments.safety: High scores route to brief intervention + LFTs.

instruments.name: PSS-4 — Perceived Stress Scale (short)
instruments.stem: In the last month, how often have you felt…
items: …unable to control the important things in your life?
…confident about your ability to handle personal problems? (reverse)
…difficulties piling up so high you could not overcome them?
instruments.scoring: Reverse items 2–3, sum 0–16; higher = more stress.
instruments.bands: green low · yellow moderate · red high

instruments.name: UCLA-3 — loneliness / social connection
instruments.scale: 1 hardly ever · 2 some of the time · 3 often
instruments.stem: How often do you feel…

instruments.name: WHO-5 — Well-Being Index
instruments.scale: 0 at no time … 5 all of the time
instruments.stem: Over the last 2 weeks…
items: I have felt cheerful and in good spirits
I have felt calm and relaxed
I have felt active and vigorous
I woke up feeling fresh and rested
My daily life has been filled with things that interest me
instruments.scoring: Sum ×4 → 0–100; <50 low well-being, <28 screen for depression.

instruments.name: ISI — Insomnia Severity Index
instruments.stem: Rate the severity of your insomnia problems in the last 2 weeks.
instruments.safety: Pairs with overnight SpO₂/ODI → OSA referral.

instruments.name: IPAQ-SF — activity (self-report, cross-checks wearable)
instruments.stem: In the last 7 days, time spent in vigorous, moderate, and walking activity (+ sitting).
instruments.scoring: Convert to MET-min/week; map to MVPA band.
instruments.safety: Self-report cross-checked vs wearable steps/MVPA for plausibility (Doc 01).

instruments.name: Diet-quality screener (Mediterranean / HEI-style)
instruments.stem: Usual weekly intake across food groups.

instruments.name: Smoking / nicotine / shisha (cross-cutting modifier)
instruments.stem: Tobacco / nicotine / waterpipe use.
instruments.scoring: Risk multiplier on CV, HEM/respiratory, INF (Doc 02 modifiers).
instruments.safety: Current use raises CV/respiratory weighting and screening.

instruments.name: TNSS — Total Nasal Symptom Score (allergic rhinitis)
instruments.stem: Rate each nasal symptom over the past 24 h / typical day.

instruments.name: ACQ — Asthma Control Questionnaire
instruments.stem: Over the past week…
instruments.safety: Uncontrolled → clinician review; pairs with peak-flow.

instruments.name: POEM — Patient-Oriented Eczema Measure
instruments.scale: 0 no days … 4 every day per item
instruments.stem: Over the last week, how many days did your skin…
instruments.bands: 0–2 clear · 3–7 mild · 8–16 moderate · 17–24 severe · 25–28 very severe

instruments.name: MRC Dyspnoea Scale (breathlessness)
instruments.stem: Which best describes your breathlessness?
items: 3 — walks slower / stops on the level
5 — too breathless to leave the house / on dressing
instruments.safety: Grade ≥4 with desaturation → expedited review (pairs with SpO₂).

instruments.name: EPDS — Edinburgh Postnatal Depression Scale
instruments.stem: In the past 7 days (perinatal mood)…
items: Able to laugh / see the funny side
Things getting on top of me
So unhappy I have been crying
instruments.safety: Item 10 > 0 (self-harm) forces MCS red/critical and fires the crisis pathway (Doc 11), like PHQ-9 item 9.

instruments.name: Mini-Cog / cognitive screen (age-adjusted)
instruments.stem: Three-word recall + clock-drawing test.
items: Draw a clock to a set time (normal = 2)
instruments.safety: Screen-positive routes to formal cognitive assessment, never an autonomous diagnosis.

instruments.name: PHQ-15 — somatic symptom burden
instruments.stem: Over the last 4 weeks, bothered by… (15 somatic symptoms)
instruments.safety: High somatic burden cross-checks MCS and the relevant organ pillars.

instruments.name: DAST-10 — Drug Abuse Screening Test
instruments.stem: In the past 12 months, regarding non-medical drug use…
items: Medical / social / legal problems from use
instruments.safety: Moderate+ routes to brief intervention / referral.

instruments.name: AUDIT — Alcohol Use Disorders Identification Test (full)
instruments.stem: Full alcohol screen when AUDIT-C is positive.

instruments.name: SARC-F — sarcopenia / frailty screen
instruments.stem: Difficulty with strength, ambulation, rising, stairs, falls.
instruments.bands: ≥4 suggests sarcopenia → grip / gait + ALMI (Doc 02 BCM)
instruments.safety: Positive routes to functional assessment + resistance-training plan.

instruments.name: PSQI — Pittsburgh Sleep Quality Index
instruments.stem: Sleep quality over the last month (7 components).
instruments.safety: Pairs with ISI + wearable sleep; high score + snoring → STOP-BANG / OSA.

instruments.name: STOP-BANG — OSA risk screen
instruments.stem: Snoring, Tiredness, Observed apnoea, Pressure (BP), BMI, Age, Neck, Gender.
instruments.safety: High risk → overnight SpO₂/ODI or HSAT (Doc 02 SLP); cross-checks ISI.

instruments.name: IIEF-5 — erectile function (male)
instruments.stem: Over the past 6 months (male sexual function)…
instruments.bands: 22–25 none · 17–21 mild · 12–16 mild-mod · 8–11 moderate · 5–7 severe ED
instruments.safety: ED can be an early CV/endothelial and low-testosterone marker — cross-check CV/ENDO.

instruments.name: MENQOL — Menopause-specific Quality of Life (female)
instruments.stem: Bother from menopausal symptoms across four domains.
instruments.safety: Severe vasomotor/sleep impact → ENDO/SLP attention; HRT decision is clinician-led.
